name: 1-800-PACK-RAT
notes: Researched from the public My PackRat sign-in page, the My PackRat FAQ PDF it links (Download FAQs) and the FAQ hub (no sign-in). My PackRat: Email Address + Password, Show Password, Login, Forgot Password; new passwords need 8+ characters with an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol. The account is created automatically when an order is placed (username and temporary password emailed), so there is no self-registration (registration unsupported). My PackRat is for local moving and storage customers only. In Manage My Orders you can update billing information, make a payment or update the credit card; My Profile -> Edit -> Update My Profile for contact details. Card is the only online method described. Recurring monthly storage billing, AutoPay, fees and cancellation terms are not published on these pages (the FAQ hub topics are behind script); autopay unknown with a contact note, cancel_service unsupported online (inferred). Customer care 1-800-722-5728, Mon-Sat 8 a.m.-10 p.m. ET, Sun 9:30 a.m.-6:30 p.m. ET. Zippy Shell is a division (same catalog record).

passwordRule.message: Your new password must have at least 8 characters, 1 uppercase letter, 1 lowercase letter, 1 number, and 1 symbol.

registration.note: Your My PackRat account is set up automatically when you place an order; we email your username and a temporary password. Questions? Call 1-800-722-5728.

autopay.note: For recurring monthly charges and card-on-file questions, call 1-800-722-5728 (Mon-Sat 8 a.m.-10 p.m. ET, Sun 9:30 a.m.-6:30 p.m. ET).

cancel_service.note: To cancel an order or end storage, call 1-800-PACK-RAT at 1-800-722-5728.

help.title: Paying in My PackRat
paragraphs: Sign in to My PackRat and pick the order in Manage My Orders. From there you can make a payment, update your credit card or billing information and schedule deliveries and pickups.
My PackRat is available to local moving and storage customers.
steps: Select My Account and log in with your email address.
Open the order in Manage My Orders.

help.title: Getting started with My PackRat
paragraphs: An account is created for you when you place an order, and you receive an email with your username and a temporary password. Sign in from the My Account link at the top of the site.

New passwords need at least 8 characters, including an uppercase letter, a lowercase letter, a number and a symbol. To change your contact details, open My Profile, choose Edit and then Update My Profile.

help.title: Contact customer care
paragraphs: Call 1-800-722-5728. Hours are Monday to Saturday 8 a.m. to 10 p.m. ET and Sunday 9:30 a.m. to 6:30 p.m. ET.

help.title: Cancelling an order
paragraphs: Order cancellations are handled by customer care. Call 1-800-722-5728.
